I also like ‘Otsal’ at Seoul National University Station, and I think this place will also become the biggest Indian restaurant!

reviews.author: ClickNDrag
reviews.text:
Although lunch sets are available, they may be expensive for students.

reviews.author: e pasteIblu
reviews.text:
The first Indian restaurant I've ever been to. When I first entered the store, I was the only customer other than the employees. I went in after seeing a sign saying the lunch menu was discounted, so I ordered lunch A. An Indian female employee took our order, but she didn't speak Korean very well. However, he was friendly and we were able to communicate roughly.

The inside of the store had a completely exotic atmosphere. I've never been to India in my life, but it's the first scene that comes to mind when you hear the word 'India' or a Bollywood movie. The interior is like that, Indian music plays non-stop, and even music videos appear on TV. Since I was visiting alone, I didn't have anything else to do, so I took some pictures here and there, looked at my phone, and waited until my meal came out.

Of course I've tried curry before, but this was my first time trying Indian curry. Nevertheless, it didn't taste very unusual. Perhaps because I don't care about the spices, it actually had a moderately rich flavor and was good. When I first received it, I thought it wasn't a lot for the price, but as I ate it, it was quite a lot. I especially enjoyed the naan. Since I was eating alone, I'm not sure if I ate it the right way...

As we ate slowly, other customers came in, and they were all Indian. I felt like a complete stranger in Seoul, which is called the heart of Korea, and in Jung-gu, the center of Seoul. It was quite refreshing because it felt like I was traveling abroad without having to buy a single plane ticket.

Naan is chewy

reviews.author: Hoon Lim
reviews.text: The food came out quickly and the pasta was all delicious. The truffle risotto was my style haha.  I have one regret. It's a popular pizza place in Euljiro, so there's usually a wait, but luckily there was only one seat left and I was able to get in right away.

The pizza is mildly delicious without being spicy, and the cheese flavor is really good. In particular, I was very satisfied with the burrata cheese because it was deeply and richly delicious.

However, the space is a bit narrow and the atmosphere is a bit chaotic, so it would be good to keep this in mind. Still, overall, I was satisfied with both the taste and the atmosphere, giving it 4 stars.

The place is small and there are only a few tables, so it gets busy when you're alone. I ate it deliciously and happily, with a spoonful of Euljiro flavor added to it.

The cream sauce of the Canebonara that I ate together is perfect, I guess you could say it adds a greasiness that isn't present in the pizza. I definitely have to order the pasta. Next time I go, I'll order two pizzas.

reviews.text: Pau Eulji-ro Branch is a donut shop that appeared in Kim Young-cheol's Neighborhood. Several branches have opened since then, but this is the first main branch to open.  It is located in Room 361, La Yeol, 3rd floor, Daelim Shopping Center, Jung-gu, Seoul. It is a 5-minute walk from Euljiro 4-ga Station and can be reached only by entering the shopping center and using the elevator or stairs. The exterior is simple and the sign is small, making it difficult to find on your first visit, but the interior is neatly organized. The store is for takeout only and does not have seating, but there is seating available on the street. Parking is available in the commercial parking lot. The representative menu item is the basic Pau donut, which is the most popular because it is crispy on the outside and chewy on the inside. There is cornmeal on the outside, giving it a nutty taste. There are a variety of menu items, such as yuzu paste, walnut red bean, and cheese stew, but the balanced sweetness and texture of the basic donut are especially outstanding. The price is reasonable at around 1,000 won, and a box discount is applied when purchasing six or more items. Since they are fried on the spot after ordering, there is a bit of waiting time, but the flavor of freshly fried donuts is unmistakable. The staff is friendly and sanitary conditions are good. It is best to eat the basic Pau donut while it is warm, and if you ask for it to be half covered in sugar, it will not be too sweet. This is a high-quality donut shop that is great for a quick snack in the Euljiro area.

reviews.text:
A place where the store is maintained with expertise and love for coffee. You can purchase 200 grams of coffee beans for around 10,000 won. Thanks to the owner who cares about eco-friendliness and nature, he brings back non-recyclable coffee bean packaging and adds 20 grams more as a service when you purchase coffee beans.

The espresso menu is so delicious... There are seasonal menus that change from time to time, so I recommend trying them all...! However, unlike other F Bars, it contains two shots of espresso, so be careful if you are sensitive to caffeine. Since it's a basic two-shot, it's really nice because you can fully enjoy the taste of the coffee.

If you ask any questions about coffee or the menu, they will explain very kindly so you can gain a lot of knowledge.

Personally, I think it is the best espresso bar. It was also a great experience to see the delicacy served in a cup that matched the coffee.

Cafe Breve, a coffee that tastes better in winter, is like a latte, with a slightly more nutty and heavy taste. The flavor of the coffee beans is deep and stays in your mouth for a long time.

Cafe Tiramisu literally tastes like tiramisu. At first, try scooping out a spoonful or two of cream (it's so delicious) and then soaking the snacks provided by dipping them in the gap between the cream. It's a seasonal menu, so I don't know when it will change :)
